statements.text: We’re putting AI to work for Southern Nevada! Thanks to the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law, @USDOT has awarded Las Vegas $2 million to use cloud technology and AI-powered analytics to support emergency vehicles and make our roads safer.

.@NSF just awarded @UNLV a CyberCorps Scholarship for Service grant for $3.1 million! 
 
The next generation of cybersecurity professionals trained in cutting-edge technologies, including AI, will be coming from right here #OnlyInDistrictOne.

As a senior member of @HouseForeign, I introduced legislation to protect the United States’s dominance in the AI race. The RESTRICT Act would prevent the sale of advanced AI chips to China and codify restrictions on the export of advanced circuits to China. https://t.co/BaSMau3nnV

I secured over $1 million for @NSHE’s Mitigating Wildfire Smoke Impacts in Nevada Project in last week’s funding bill. This will enable @DRIScience to partner with @NASA to better track, map, and forecast fires and smoke with satellite technology and AI. 

As wildfires become more frequent and more dangerous, we must invest in technology to protect lives and forests.

Congratulations to #OnlyInDistrictOne’s 2026 @CongressionalAC winner Matthew Caliboso. His impressive app TechMate is an AI-powered platform designed to help seniors navigate technology, get tech support, and protect themselves from scams. https://t.co/opSkrxKVH4
This is what happens when you fire smart, experienced diplomats and replace them with AI. https://t.co/R3yX22ukcX

statements.text: Data centers are proliferating in Nevada and other states having large expanses of federal land. We need to make sure the public's voice is heard and that the effects on the environment, water resources and the electric grid are thoroughly assessed and made public.
statements.venue: Press release introducing the Public Lands Accountability Act (data centers on federal land; release cites the administration's push for AI data centers)

statements.text:
Too much is at stake to leave traffic management decisions up to a computer. As a Senior Member of @TransportDems, I will continue to exercise Congressional oversight of AI development and use to ensure that safety is the top priority in air traffic control modernization.
https://t.co/gsHdVtss7f

Thank you for bringing @BLET to #OnlyInDistrictOne and for recognizing me as a "true friend to labor." As Ranking Member of the @TransportDems Rail Subcommittee, I am fighting for the issues important to you: surface transportation reauthorization, rail safety, and the impact of AI on the rail workforce.
Railroads think it'll save them money, but it shouldn't replace humans,
statements.venue: Remarks to BLET convention on AI replacing railroad workers (reported by BLET)
